route: Artistic work permit (Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals, art. 10)

permit.applies: The artist applies directly to the Ministry of Labor, online, without an employer (art. 10); an employer may instead apply for an employment permit for artistic and performing art work under the Employment Service Act (arts. 46(1)(6) and 48), the route layer 3 held. The Ministry reviews the application in consultation with the Ministry of Culture.
permit.first: The job qualifications listed in the regulations' addendum, the review fee paid, and no unpermitted artistic work or false application in the previous three years.

fees.what: Review fee, artistic work permit or its extension

permit.eligibility: "Movie, Broadcasting Television, and Pop Music: refers to engaging in the cultural arts by creating, producing, performing, promoting, teaching or sharing (such as workshops or lectures), jury panels, agency, managing or technology, in the fields of film, broadcasting, television and pop music."
permit.pay: No minimum pay: the foreign employee roster's monthly salary may be the contract amount, 'as specified in the contract', 'group expense' or 'gratis' (WDA handbook for foreign artists and performers, 2020).
permit.exemptNote: None: the Employment Service Act's exemptions (art. 48(1)) don't include performers, and no days without a permit are set.

sources.title: Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals (amended 2025-09-24), art. 10
sources.said: A foreign professional who works as an artist may apply directly to the Ministry of Labor for a permit to engage in artistic work in the State. Such a work permit shall be for a maximum term of three years, and when necessary, an application for extension may be made for up to three years each time.

sources.title: Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Regulations on the Work Permit and Administration of Foreign Professionals Engaging in Arts and Performing Arts (amended 2023-12-18)
sources.said: Movie, Broadcasting Television, and Pop Music: refers to engaging in the cultural arts by creating, producing, performing, promoting, teaching or sharing (such as workshops or lectures), jury panels, agency, managing or technology, in the fields of film, broadcasting, television and pop music. … Foreign professionals engaging in artistic work prescribed in the provisions of the preceding Article are required to have one of the following job qualifications listed in the addendum. … Engaged in artistic work without permission. … Prior to approving the provisions of the preceding Article, the ministry is required to conduct an examination and review in consultation with the Ministry of Culture. … foreign professionals applying for a permit to undertake art related work should do so online

sources.title: Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Fee-charging Standards for Application Review Under "Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals" by Ministry of Labor (amended 2025-12-26, in force 1 January 2026)
sources.said: Foreign professionals who apply for a permit to engage in artistic work, or the extension of such a permit, in accordance with Article 10 of the Act are required to pay NT$500 per application.

sources.title: Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Employment Service Act (amended 2025-01-20), arts. 46 and 48
sources.said: 6.Religious, artistic, and performing art related work. … Employers must apply to the Central Competent Authority for an employment permit before employing a foreign worker, submitting all relevant documents.

sources.title: Workforce Development Agency (Ministry of Labor), Work Permit Application Review Guidelines Handbook for Foreign Artists and Performers (F-109-V01, February 2020), linked from EZ Work Taiwan
sources.said: Work Permit Application Review Guidelines Handbook for Foreign Artists and Performers … 8 Review Days The days required to review the applications for the employment of foreigners (according to the Announcement Lao-Dong-Fa- Shi-Zi No. 1040516707 dated January 29, 2016) are as follows: 1. Online application: If application documents are complete, and both the employer and the foreign worker meet the stipulated qualifications and … the Ministry of Labor shall review the applications within 7 working days from the next day of receipt. … Labor shall review the applications within 12 working days from the next day of receipt. … 2. “Monthly salary” shall be entered with the actual amount specified in an employment contract signed between the employer and the employed foreign worker, “as specified in the contract,” “group expense,” or “gratis.”

sources.title: Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Employment Service Act (amended 2025-01-20), Chapter 5 (arts. 42-62), English text
sources.said: Article 46 Employers hiring foreign nationals to work in the Republic of China are limited to the following categories ... 6.Religious, artistic, and performing ar[tists] ... Article 47 (Ⅰ)Employers intending to hire foreign workers for work categories listed in Subparagraphs 8 to 11 of Paragraph 1 of Article 46 must first attempt domestic recruitment ... employers are required to: notify the labor union or the workers of the business entity about the full details of such recruitment ... Article 48 (Ⅰ)Employers must apply to the Central Competent Authority for an employment permit before employing a foreign worker, submitting all relevant documents. Exemptions from this requirement include: 1 .Foreign workers employed as consultants or researchers by the government or its subordinate academic research institutes. 2. Foreign workers married to nationals of the Republic of China with a registered residence in the country and permitted to stay. 3. Foreigners employed in public or registered private colleges/universities in lecturing or academic research roles approved by the Ministry of Education.

note: The 7 working days are the Ministry's review time for an online application with complete documents (12 for a paper one), counted from the day after receipt. Read 2026-11-04: the Employment Service Act's foreign-employment chapter, read whole: the union notice of art. 47 binds only blue-collar categories, and the artistic work permit asks no union step.
